watchers._comment: EPSON 에코솔벤 2호기 — status-aware 전환 (2026-08-11 실측: 완료=12·취소=2, 정착 규칙 쿼리. 정본 해설=equipment.json.example EPSON 블록).
watchers.name: EPSON-02

config.query: SELECT j.JobID, j.JobName, j.JobStatus, CASE WHEN l.FinishPrintTime IS NULL OR l.FinishPrintTime LIKE '0001%' THEN (CASE WHEN l.StartPrintTime IS NULL OR l.StartPrintTime LIKE '0001%' THEN l.EntryTime ELSE l.StartPrintTime END) ELSE l.FinishPrintTime END AS FinishPrintTime, p.OriginalSizeWidth, p.OriginalSizeHeight FROM Job j LEFT JOIN Log l ON j.JobID = l.JobID LEFT JOIN Page p ON j.JobID = p.JobID AND p.PageID = 1 WHERE j.JobID > @last_id AND (j.JobStatus = 12 OR (j.JobStatus = 2 AND j.JobID < (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(j2.JobID), 0) FROM Job j2 WHERE j2.JobStatus = 12))) ORDER BY j.JobID
